feed.title: Business News - Markets reports and financial news from Sky

articles.title: German bidder stages last-gasp bid to rescue Poundland
articles.summary: A German investment firm has made a last-minute entry into the race to save Poundland, just days before its directors face the bleak prospect of appointing administrators to one of Britain's biggest high street retailers.

articles.title: Ladbrokes-owner Entain in talks with CVC after gambling tax hit
articles.summary: The London-listed owner of Ladbrokes and Coral is in talks to sell part of its business to one of the world's biggest private equity firms as it tries to mitigate the impact of Labour's latest tax raid on the gambling industry.

articles.title: Poundland chief shares pain with staff amid last-ditch rescue talks
articles.summary: Poundland's boss has told thousands of employees at the discount chain of his "hurt" at the parlous position in which it finds itself, days before it faces collapsing into administration.

articles.title: British Gas owner Centrica cuts hundreds of jobs in Business unit
articles.summary: The FTSE 100 energy company Centrica is cutting hundreds of jobs as part of a cost-saving drive.

articles.title: Anthropic among big fallers in global stock market rout
articles.summary: Shares in Anthropic have fallen by more than 10% at Friday's open on Wall Street, just a day after their record-breaking Nasdaq debut, as part of a global stock market rout.

articles.title: Gulf wholesaler makes late entry in dash to save Poundland
articles.summary: A Gulf-based wholesale group has made a late entrance into the race to save Poundland just days before the discount retailer faces collapsing into administration.

articles.title: Households stockpiling 'emergency items' boosts retail sales
articles.summary: Shoppers appear to be heeding government warnings to stock-up on essentials amid a surprise leap in retail sales.

articles.title: Poundland bosses warn of funding squeeze in fresh talks with minister
articles.summary: Poundland's bosses have told the government that the discount retailer faces a further funding crisis just days before a cliff-edge which could lead to its collapse.

articles.title: Former Tesco executive Wheway in talks to chair Sainsbury's
articles.summary: A former Tesco executive is among the candidates vying to become the next chairman of arch-rival Sainsbury's.
